title: Implement prediction settlement engine (backend APIs + admin trigger)

requirements.text:
Implement backend settlement engine APIs so predictions can be settled and the existing frontend settlement UI (Settings page + metrics modules) no longer relies on placeholder data.

Backend must add Candid-exposed methods:
- shared runSettlementNow() : async () (admin-only)
- query getSettlementDiagnostics() : async SettlementDiagnostics (admin-only)
- query getSettlementMetrics() : async SettlementMetrics (authenticated user)

Backend must also define the SettlementDiagnostics and SettlementMetrics record types to match the shapes expected by the existing frontend hooks (including Time.Time timestamps and bigint-compatible counters), and ensure calls do not trap for authorized callers.
acceptanceCriteria: Calling runSettlementNow as a non-admin traps with a clear authorization error message.
Calling runSettlementNow as an admin succeeds and updates settlement diagnostics counters/timestamps.
Calling getSettlementDiagnostics as an admin returns a complete record with all fields populated (no placeholder behavior needed on the frontend).
Calling getSettlementDiagnostics as a non-admin traps with a clear authorization error message.
Calling getSettlementMetrics as an authenticated user returns a complete record with all fields populated (no placeholder behavior needed on the frontend).
None of these methods trap for authorized callers due to missing internal data (e.g., empty prediction set).

requirements.text:
Add backend logic to actually settle predictions stored in the existing settleablePredictions map.

On each runSettlementNow():
- Update settlement diagnostics (lastAttempt, totals).
- Identify predictions with settlementStatus == #active and gameStatus == #completed.
- Mark those predictions as #settled and set outcome/resultValue deterministically (no randomness) so results are reproducible.
- Record how many predictions were settled in that run (numSettledInLastRun).
- Update settlement diagnostics lastSuccess/lastFailure fields appropriately.

If there are no eligible predictions to settle, the call must still succeed and report numSettledInLastRun = 0.
acceptanceCriteria: If there are active predictions with gameStatus == #completed, after runSettlementNow() they are returned from getSettleablePrediction() with settlementStatus == #settled and outcome != null.
If there are no eligible predictions, runSettlementNow() completes successfully and increments attempt counters while leaving lastFailure unset (or unchanged) and reporting numSettledInLastRun = 0.
Settlement behavior is deterministic (re-running settlement without new eligible predictions does not change already-settled outcomes).

requirements.text:
Compute and expose settlement performance metrics in getSettlementMetrics() using the settled predictions in settleablePredictions.

At minimum, metrics must include:
- totalSettled / totalWon / totalLost / totalPush
- sevenDayWinRate (as a 0..1 float)
- totalROI (as a float)

If there are zero settled predictions, return zeros for metrics (and totalSettled = 0).
acceptanceCriteria: When at least one prediction is settled, getSettlementMetrics().totalSettled > 0 and won/lost/push counters sum to totalSettled.
sevenDayWinRate is a valid number in [0,1] and matches the settled outcomes considered for the 7-day window (based on timestamps available on predictions).
totalROI is returned as a valid number (not NaN/Infinity) even if some optional fields like odds or betAmount are missing on predictions (use safe defaults).
When there are no settled predictions, getSettlementMetrics returns sevenDayWinRate = 0, totalROI = 0, and all counters are 0.

requirements.text:
Update the frontend settlement flow so the existing settlement UI uses the newly implemented backend methods end-to-end.

Specifically:
- Ensure the Settings page admin section provides a working action to trigger settlement (runSettlementNow) and that, on success, the settlement diagnostics and settlement metrics sections update without a full page reload.
- Ensure user-facing error messages remain in English and are appropriate if the backend traps (unauthorized) or fails unexpectedly.
acceptanceCriteria: As an authenticated admin, triggering settlement from the Settings page successfully runs the backend method and the UI updates the displayed diagnostics/metrics (via React Query invalidation) within a short time.
As a non-admin authenticated user, the admin settlement section remains blocked by the existing AdminOnly gate; no settlement action is available.
If the backend returns an error while running settlement, the UI shows an English error toast/message and does not get stuck in a loading state.

constraints: Backend must remain single-actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Building a full predictions browsing UI (list/detail pages) beyond what already exists.
Integrating external settlement data providers or real-time game result ingestion.
Implementing automated scheduled settlement runs (cron-style); only manual/admin-triggered settlement is required.
